title: DecisionDesk
pitch: DecisionDesk is a collaborative, client-side engineering workbench for Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA) integrated with an in-browser Model Context Protocol (WebMCP) server.

 Inspiration 

 Developing and building webmcp is a creative idea and resolves issues. 

 What it does 

 Instead of relying on disorganized spreadsheets, biased debates, or gut feelings, DecisionDesk gives engineering teams and autonomous AI agents a shared, mathematically sound decision space. 

 How we built it 

 Github repository was created, webapp was built on google and tested on chrome console. 

 Challenges we ran into 

 Github creation was challenging and finding appropriate agent to run encountered some failures. 

 Accomplishments that we're proud of 

 Webapp that helps to meet the project objectives. 

 What we learned 

 WebMCP is effective tool and methods to find alternative solutions. 

 What's next for DecisionDesk 

 Integration with other platforms
